items.quote: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
items.claim: The text says Noah's sons were Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and that they had sons after the flood.
items.actor: Shem, Ham, and Japheth (sons of Noah)
items.mechanism: The verse opens a family line ("these are the generations") and places the births after the flood.
